about_the_game:
In Orcs and Outlaws, Protectorate bounty hunters wage war against the hidden legions of Orcs, who rise once more to reclaim their dominion over the human species. Fight the Orc hordes, uncover their secret plots, and stand between mankind and the ethereal darkness gathering to consume it.

- A new breed of Orc warriors rises from the ashes of the old world
-  Commanding legions of dragons, demons, and the undead
-  Engage in brutal melee, devastating spellcraft, and relentless ranged combat
-  Journey through vast, foreboding realms of epic dark fantasy

ORCS, VAMPIRES, DEMONS AND MORE

Protectorate monitors whisper of terrifying sightings, creatures of myth and nightmare emerging from the world’s most desolate frontiers. Dragons soaring through storm-lit skies. Giants striding across forgotten ruins. Beasts beyond mortal reckoning. In the shadows, the Orcs have grown stronger in their clandestine bases, uniting with demons and the undead to forge an unholy alliance that threatens the realm of man.

Infernal knights - formidable warriors of the demonic realm

Fight against deadly venomous Racnoirs

FIGHT OR FLIGHT

To infiltrate an Orc stronghold, stealth, speed, and stamina are your only allies. Only Protectorate hunters may breach these hidden fortresses, through portals woven with ancient magic. No modern weapon may cross their threshold. Inside, you must scavenge whatever arms the shadows offer. Ammunition is scarce. Every strike, every shot must count. Choose your battles wisely, or become the hunted.

DARK FANTASY DOMAINS

Hidden deep within cursed forests, crumbling castles, and forgotten ruins lie the hidden demonic strongholds of the Orcs. Shrouded by ancient wards and cloaked from mortal sight, their fortresses exist beyond the reach of man. To survive, you must navigate treacherous terrain and unravel the mysteries buried within each fortress. Scan every shadow, study every path, only then can you breach the inner sanctums and unlock the gateway portals that bind their dark dominion.

BACKGROUND

They have always existed. Before human time could be measured, Orcs thrived in the darkness. Led astray by the Dark Lords during the Genesis Wars, they survived the centuries by becoming independent and imperceptible. Unseen and undetectable, they grew in strength, forging alliances with demons and the undead. Cloaked by mystical wards, their hidden camps lay beyond the eyes and ears of men.

Aware of their growing ethereal power, the earliest kingdoms declared the Orcs and their rogue spirits outlaws and issued a perpetual bounty for their capture. Unknown to most, and operating in the most remote corners of the world, demonic bounty hunters continue to track and pursue these creatures. These uniquely skilled hunters are known as the Protectorate.

Ava Volkira is an elite Protectorate hunter. On a recent mission, she uncovered evidence of two new Orc tribes: the Primas and the Provecta. Both have thrived in secrecy, honing their strength and intellect. They are no longer the barbaric beings depicted in ancient tales, but a sophisticated and strategic race, ready to reclaim their place in the world.

content_descriptors.notes: As a 3D shooting game, it contains imagery and animations of human characters getting harmed and shot. Though not realistic violence (compared to movies), it would not be suitable for children or any other young person who has not played similar games. An equivalent movie rating would be PG13.
